title: Mini project: a profile page
summary: Combine what you have learned to build a complete, accessible personal profile page.

docs.title: MDN: Structuring a page of content

quiz.q: Put these build steps in a sensible order.
lines: Link the nav to the sections
Check the page with Tab and a validator
quiz.explain: Work from the outside in: skeleton first, then the big regions, then details, then connections, and finally checks.

quiz.q: The nav link is `<a href="#skills">`. What must the Skills section have?
quiz.explain: An in-page link jumps to the element whose `id` equals the text after `#`.

quiz.q: Which pair gives a data table both a title and header cells?
quiz.explain: `caption` titles the table and `th` marks header cells.

exercise.task: Build a profile page in `index.html`. Replace the placeholder comments with real content. - ``, a `` and a `<header>` with an `<h1>` (your name) and a `<nav>` with 3 links to `#about`, `#skills` and `#contact`. - A `<main>` with sections whose ids are `about`, `skills`, `projects` and `contact`, each with an `<h2>`. - About: a paragraph and an `<img>` with `alt`, `width` and `height`. - Skills: a `<ul>` with 3 or more items. - Projects: a table with a `<caption>`, 2 `<th scope="col">` and 2 body rows. - Contact: a form with a labelled email input (required), a labelled `<textarea>` and a submit button. - An external link with `target="_blank"` and `rel="noopener"`. - A `<footer>` with `©`.
hints: Start with the landmarks and the four section ids, then fill in one section at a time.
Reuse your earlier exercises: the nav links match the ids, labels use for and id, the table has caption, thead and tbody.

Asha Kumar

checks.name: The page has a title and lang="en"
checks.hint: Add <html lang="en"> and a <title> in the head.

checks.name: The header has an h1 and a nav with 3 links to #about, #skills and #contact
checks.hint: Add header > h1 and nav with links to the section ids.
checks.selector: body > header nav a[href="#about"], body > header nav a[href="#skills"], body > header nav a[href="#contact"]

checks.name: The header contains an h1 with your name
checks.hint: Put your name in an h1 inside the header.

checks.name: main has sections with ids about, skills, projects and contact
checks.hint: Give each <section> one of the four ids.
checks.selector: main > section#about, main > section#skills, main > section#projects, main > section#contact

checks.name: The about section has an image with alt, width and height
The image alt text is not empty
checks.hint: Describe the picture in the alt.

checks.name: The skills section has a list of at least 3 items
The projects table has a caption and 2 header cells
The table has two scoped header cells
The table body has at least 2 rows
The contact form has a required email input
checks.hint: Add <input id="email" name="email" type="email" required> inside the form.

checks.name: The email input has a label
checks.hint: Add <label for="email">Email</label> that matches the input id.

checks.name: The contact form has a textarea
The form has a submit button
An external link opens in a new tab safely
checks.hint: Add a link starting with https:// that has target="_blank" and rel="noopener".

checks.name: The footer contains a copyright sign written as ©
The source uses © for the sign
